firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting player and give them six dollars. That player takes the first turn, followed clockwise.
clarifications: The other players receive seven, eight, or nine dollars in clockwise order during setup. These amounts follow the chosen order; they are not a criterion for choosing it.
On each player’s first turn, place the cattleman on any neutral building tile and continue with phase B.
